bullets.title: Baobest Baobab Fruit Powder, 16 Ounce
bullets.note:
\-- I’m using baobab mostly for its **prebiotic** properties, as I’m coming
off of short-term antibiotic use. I often mix it with whey protein, hydrolyzed
collagen, and water in a morning shake. But how do prebiotics differ from the
ever popular probiotics? In simple terms, eating _pro_ biotics is consuming
live bacteria, which you hope make it to your gut intact; eating _pre_ biotics
is consuming fertilizer to support your own GI growth of beneficial bacteria.
Most common prebiotics have high fiber content, and one microbiologist I know
believes this fiber variable explains why the [slow-carb
diet](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/xmumv0zqqa6hpr2k7/ly60ym/aHR0cDovL3RpbS5ibG9nLzIwMTIvMDcvMTIvaG93LXRvLWxvc2UtMTAwLXBvdW5kcy8=)
